section_summary.extract_value: This appendix presents the 'State Body Appreciation Scale' with directions instructing participants to rate items from 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree) based on how they feel right now. It includes example item 10: 'At this moment, I feel like I am beautiful even if I am different from media images of attractive people...' No study identifiers, sample characteristics, methods, or results are provided in this section.
section_summary.evidence_source: "Appendix A. State Body Appreciation Scale." "Directions for participants: for each of the items below, choose the option that best describes how you feel RIGHT NOW, AT THIS VERY MOMENT: 1 = strongly disagree, 2 = disagree, 3 = neutral, 4 = agree, 5 = strongly agree." "10. At this moment, I feel like I am beautiful even if I am different from media images of attractive people (e.g., models, actresses/actors)."
